events.name: ypy:test:idle
events.description: Fires on the document when a `ypy.idle()` call resolves: no request in flight, no swap or settle pending, and the quiet period passed. `waited` is how long the call waited, in milliseconds.

config.name: test
config.description: Defaults of `ypy.idle()` (how long it waits, the quiet period). While work is pending `ypy-test` also writes `data-ypy-busy` on `<html>` and removes it when the work ends: the value lists the kinds of work, space separated (`request` in flight, `queued` in an `ypy-sync` queue, `swap` being inserted, `settle` settling). It is output for tests and styles, never something to write by hand.

config.name: test.timeout
config.description: Milliseconds `ypy.idle()` waits before it rejects with an error that names the work still pending. `0` waits for ever. A time such as `"2s"` also works.

config.name: test.quiet
config.description: Milliseconds the page must stay without pending work before `ypy.idle()` resolves; content just swapped in may start the next request (a `load` trigger) in that time. `0` resolves at once.
